claim: A run of Ambrose's launcher on r806919.Wizard_1_610 that starts the real client (WizardGraphicalClient.exe) leaves the retail install unchanged: SHA-256 listings of all 16,936 install files are identical before and after, the client exits with status 0, and the launcher writes its generated files only to its own run folder.
disproof: A launcher run on r806919.Wizard_1_610 that starts the client and changes any retail-install file hash, or writes a generated file inside the install, would refute this finding.
evidence: The launcher reported install C:/ProgramData/KingsIsle Entertainment/Wizard101 (r806919.Wizard_1_610) and started "C:\ProgramData\KingsIsle Entertainment\Wizard101\Bin\WizardGraphicalClient.exe" with -L 127.0.0.1 12000 -P 0 -A en-US.
The client ran and, after being closed normally, the launcher reported "the client exited with 0".
The launcher wrote its run-folder files (config.xml, WizardClient.log) only to the ProjectAmbrose run folder, not to the retail install.
The complete retail-install hash listings contained 16,936 entries both before and after, with zero differences.
how_to_repeat: Read Bin/revision.dat from your own install and confirm it reports r806919.Wizard_1_610.
Record SHA-256 hashes of every file in the retail install, sorted by relative path.
Build the launcher in Release (RelWithDebInfo) and run it against your own install; let it start WizardGraphicalClient.exe.
Close the client normally and let the launcher report its exit status.
Hash the retail install again and compare the sorted before and after listings.
subject: launcher_client_run_install_unchanged
